about: Axis Bank Limited provides various financial products and services in India and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Treasury, Retail Banking, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Business. It provides fixed, recurring, and safe deposits; and saving, salary, current, safe custody, pension disbursement, and demat and trading accounts.
